propositions: Hand-maintained package help artifacts are stale relative to runtime parser factories post-S2b/S2c, causing drift in option definitions and command descriptions.

Generator script must enumerate canonical/compatibility/hidden routes from registry, resolve parser factories deterministically, and render artifacts with fixed prog/width/formatter/ordering/UTF-8 policy, failing on any missing/stale/empty per-command summary.
Top-level help routing and lexical pre-scan must be cut to registry and committed artifacts before operation/config/store/parser/handler resolution boundaries.
Factory enrichment via per-argument help= text and description/epilog replaces hand-authored usage lines and option tables, with no manual text concatenated after generation.

Existing help consumers outside _cli/help/ (gen_cli_reference.py, test suites, runtime sites like _bridge_commands and transition.py) must remain valid via regenerated factory-derived bytes and capitalized Usage: prefix preservation.
All 21 formerly intercept-only help forms must succeed safely; overview grouping, help determinism, and hand-captured drift correction are approved behavioral changes.
